description: Returns the calling API key's account info and current usage: plan tier, rate limits (per minute in requests, per day / month in credits), credits used and left, and enabled scopes. It also returns the purposes declared for the account and for this key (declared_purposes, key_purposes; null until declared) and the legal documents the account accepted (accepted_documents: document, version, day, link). Costs no credits. Use this to check "how many credits do I have left?".
name: account
title: Get account and credits
